oracle.name: Power Pages
oracle.scope: Two signed-in loads on 2026-11-26 (runs pcf1, pcf2) of three basic form pages whose form subgrids host the invented dataset probe in four parent-relationship variants: an edit form of the parent row with a self-referential 1:N subgrid (two child rows), a subgrid without a relationship (the whole view, five rows, page size 3) and a 1:N subgrid without child rows; the same form in insert mode (no parent record: the requests send entityId ""); and an edit form whose subgrid follows a custom activity's polymorphic regarding relationship (two activities regarding the parent). The status, MoreRecords flag and record ids of each subgrid data request. Establishes which rows the subgrid service returns per parent relationship and in insert mode; not column values, markup or client behaviour.
